name: theme
title: Terminal Theme
description: The tokens, typography, motion and CRT effects used by every component.

name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Sections that open one at a time or many. The marker is a plus that rotates into a minus.

name: alert
title: Alert
description: A notice with a lit left edge and a matching icon. Four tones.

name: alert-dialog
title: Alert Dialog
description: A pink confirmation dialog for destructive or irreversible actions.

name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: Initials in mono inside a bordered square.

name: badge
title: Badge
description: A bordered rectangle of tracked-out mono for a status or a count. Eight variants.

name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: A path in mono, separated by slashes, with the current segment in white.

name: button
title: Button
description: Seven variants and five sizes in uppercase mono. `primary` is filled phosphor; `signal` marks urgent states.

name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: A square month grid with phosphor selection, an amber today marker and Afterglow navigation buttons.

name: card
title: Card
description: A panel with a colored left edge, or `accent={false}` for none. With a `CardLink`, the edge traces the card on hover.

name: chart
title: Chart
description: Recharts wired to the five chart colors, terminal tooltip and stepped reveal.

name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: `[ ]` and `[x]`. A square that fills with the beam when it is on.

name: code-block
title: Code Block
description: Shiki wired to the phosphor palette, with a copy button. Takes a string of code and highlights it on the server.

name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: The accordion without the styling, for when you have drawn the trigger yourself.

name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: A text field that filters its list as you type. With `multiple` set, each pick becomes a chip in the field.

name: command
title: Command
description: A search line and a list that narrows as you type. Groups, shortcuts, and a dialog wrapper.

name: context-menu
title: Context Menu
description: A system menu at the pointer, with choices, submenus, shortcut hints and destructive actions.

name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: Opens in four steps rather than on a curve, with one pass of the beam down the panel.

name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown Menu
description: Items, checkbox and radio items, submenus, and shortcut hints in the same mono as the keys.

name: empty
title: Empty
description: A dashed hairline box for a list with nothing in it.

name: hover-card
title: Hover Card
description: A bordered preview panel for a link, with one phosphor edge and room for interactive content.

name: input
title: Input
description: A hairline field in mono with a phosphor caret. Focus brightens the border instead of adding a ring.

name: input-group
title: Input Group
description: Icons, text and buttons inside a field's border. The whole group glows while the control in it has focus.

name: input-otp
title: Input OTP
description: One cell per character, with a drawn caret in the active one.

name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: A key with two pixels of implied depth under it. Pass `glyph` for `⌘`, `⇧` and `↵`.

name: label
title: Label
description: A field's name, set as an eyebrow. Small, tracked out, phosphor.

name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Page numbers as joined cells, so a run of them reads as one control.

name: popover
title: Popover
description: A bordered panel anchored to its trigger.

name: progress
title: Progress
description: Three pixels of track and a light in it. Pass `indeterminate` for a segment that sweeps and leaves.

name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: Terminal-style radio marks in their unchecked and checked states: `( )` and `(•)`.

name: resizable
title: Resizable
description: Panels split by a hairline that lights when you take hold of it.

name: scroll-area
title: Scroll Area
description: A hairline track and a square thumb, in place of the operating system's own.

name: select
title: Select
description: A trigger that reads as a field, and a list whose chosen row carries a lit left edge.

name: separator
title: Separator
description: One pixel of the border color, horizontal or vertical.

name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A drawer from any of the four edges. The edge it slides from keeps a lit border.

name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Placeholder rows in dim phosphor.

name: slider
title: Slider
description: A hairline track, a lit range, and a square handle. Single value or range.

name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: A lit pixel travelling a 3x3 grid, four brightness levels trailing behind it.

name: switch
title: Switch
description: A squared-off rocker in two sizes.

name: table
title: Table
description: A manifest in mono with hairline rules. `is-numeric` gives a cell amber tabular figures.

name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Two variants: joined segments and a quieter line.

name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: A multiline field that grows with its content.

name: toast
title: Toast
description: Sonner alerts that blink into place with a border, tint and icon for each tone.

name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: A button that stays down.

name: toggle-group
title: Toggle Group
description: Toggles joined the way the segmented tabs are.

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A compact label with one lit edge and no arrow.

name: alarm-button
title: Alarm Button
description: Two flashes and a rest, the way a warning lamp blinks. Pointing at it stops the flashing.

name: boot-log
title: Boot Log
description: A self test that prints itself line by line, at its final height from the first frame.

name: caret
title: Caret
description: A blinking block that follows the surrounding font size.

name: connector
title: Connector
description: A rule extending left or right from a heading.

name: eyebrow
title: Eyebrow
description: The tracked-out line above a heading, with an optional block caret.

name: led
title: LED
description: A status lamp and the line it sits in. Four tones, and the idle one holds still.

name: prompt
title: Prompt
description: A shell line. Sigil, field and caret share one row with no border between them.

name: scanlines
title: Scanlines
description: The glass. Two densities, a multiply blend, and a fixed mode for putting a whole page behind one sheet.

name: screen
title: Screen
description: A framed CRT surface. Scanlines by default, with the aperture grille, bloom, roll bar and grain opt in.

name: shell
title: Shell
description: A command transcript and prompt with command history. Bring the commands and their effects.

name: terminal-window
title: Terminal Window
description: Window chrome in three conventions: macOS, Windows, or a slim hairline version. Resizable and collapsible.

name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: A calendar, popover and button composed into an installable single-date picker.

name: operator-dashboard
title: Operator Dashboard
description: A full-page operations dashboard with boot status, volume health, rebuild progress and a shell.

name: terminal
title: Terminal Preset
description: The shared theme and every registry component in one `shadcn init` preset.

name: typewriter
title: Typewriter
description: A line that types itself one character at a time, at its finished width from the first frame.

name: scramble
title: Scramble
description: Text resolving out of glyph soup, left to right. On mount, on hover, or when it scrolls into view.

name: grain
title: Grain
description: Tube noise over anything. A static filter by default, or a capped canvas loop that pauses off screen.

name: glitch
title: Glitch
description: Channel separation over a subtree. Two colour-shifted copies clipped into bands that jump on steps.
